name: c-item-1
title: Basic item with title and description
label: Variants
description: Basic item with title and description

guidance.bestFor: The 3 row variants stacked for comparison, default, outline and muted, as text only rows with no media or actions

whenNotToUse.when: A single record that needs a header line above the title and a footer below
A stacked group of people, each with a photo and a presence label

name: c-item-2
title: Items with icon media and action buttons
label: Icon & Actions
description: Items with icon media and action buttons

guidance.bestFor: Notification channel rows at the default size, each a leading icon and 1 button, outline Configure or filled Enable
agentNotes: The Configure and Enable `Button` elements have no handler; open the channel settings or flip its state from them

name: c-item-3
title: User item with avatar, info, and follow button
label: User Follow
description: User item with avatar, info, and follow button

guidance.bestFor: Compact people rows with a photo and job title that show the follow button in both states, Follow and Following
agentNotes: Follow and Following are 2 fixed `Button` variants with no state; keep a following flag per person to swap label and variant

whenNotToUse.when: A feed of who did what and when, one person per row with a timestamp

name: c-item-4
title: Clickable navigation items with icons and chevron
label: Navigation Links
description: Clickable navigation items with icons and chevron

guidance.bestFor: Account menu links, Profile, Security and Billing, where each whole row is an anchor and separators divide them
agentNotes: Every row is an anchor whose `href` is #; set each to its route, passed through `render` on base or `asChild` on radix

whenNotToUse.when: Folder links that show an unread count beside the label

guidance.bestFor: Team presence rows in a spaced group, each with a photo, a role and an Online, Away or Offline badge
agentNotes: Each presence `Badge` variant is typed by hand per person; map your live status to success, warning or outline

whenNotToUse.when: Members who need a role label plus a menu of row actions

name: c-item-6
title: File items with icon media, size, and actions
label: File Rows
description: File items with icon media, size, and actions

guidance.bestFor: File rows with size and last update, a Final, Draft or Review badge and an Open button on each
agentNotes: Each row picks its `IconPlaceholder` by hand; choose it from the file extension once the rows come from data

whenNotToUse.when: An icon that shows a document format with a colored extension label

guidance.bestFor: A narrow command menu of 5 link rows, each an icon and label with its key combination in a Kbd on the right
agentNotes: `commands` lists Mac only chords such as ⌘K and nothing listens for them; bind the keys and show Ctrl on other platforms

whenNotToUse.when: A searchable palette that narrows actions as the user types

guidance.bestFor: Mailbox folder links from Inbox to Trash in a narrow column, with a rounded count badge on Inbox and Drafts only
agentNotes: `menuItems` shows the count `Badge` only when `count` is above 1, so a folder holding exactly 1 item shows none

whenNotToUse.when: Menu rows that print a keyboard chord beside each action
A full app side navigation with grouped sections that collapses

name: c-item-9
title: Team members with roles and multiple actions
label: Team Roles
description: Team members with roles and multiple actions

guidance.bestFor: Member rows with email under the name, a role badge and a dots menu of Change Role, View Profile and Remove
agentNotes: `members` holds 3 sample people with a `roleVariant` each; load your team and map every role to a `Badge` variant
Change Role, View Profile and Remove are `DropdownMenuItem` entries with no handler; attach your member actions to each

whenNotToUse.when: A members roster compared across aligned columns of role and status

name: c-item-10
title: Item with header and footer sections
label: Header & Footer
description: Item with header and footer sections

guidance.bestFor: A narrow project card: kind label and In Progress badge on top, avatar stack and a 65% progress bar below
agentNotes: `Progress` `value` and the 65% label beside it are typed separately; derive both from one number

whenNotToUse.when: A larger tile with an image, body copy and footer buttons

guidance.bestFor: Data source rows where linked services show a Connected badge and the rest offer a Connect button
agentNotes: Connected `Badge` and Connect `Button` are set by hand per row; choose one from each integration's status and wire Connect

name: c-item-12
title: Activity feed items with avatars and actions
label: Activity Feed
description: Activity feed items with avatars and actions

guidance.bestFor: A team log of deploys, merges and issues: a small photo, the person, a colored verb badge, the target and a relative time
agentNotes: `activities` rows are keyed by `index`; key them by a stable event id when the feed can change

whenNotToUse.when: Events placed along a vertical line with a marker for each step
